## 🏛️ Case / Template Proposal Protocol

*Before submitting, ensure your proposal is grounded entirely in objective technical facts, storefront disclosures, or public developer patch notes. Emotional rants or low-effort internet slang will result in the immediate closure of this thread.*

### I. The Target Environment
* **Game Title / Studio Name:** [e.g., Unity Engine / Notovia / Chilla's Art]
* **Ecosystem / Software Architecture:** [e.g., Unreal Engine stock assets, Claude Code backend, or specific localized compression artifacts]

### II. The Substance (The Structural Choice)
<!-- Provide a clear, technical description of what the developer actually did, or what engine-specific optimization shortcut is triggering false audience paranoia. -->

### III. The Shadow (The Selective Outrage)
<!-- Document the precise nature of the audience backlash. What false arguments, low-effort buzzwords (e.g., "slop," "lazy"), or ideological double standards were weaponized by the community? -->

### IV. The Turning Point (Vindication, Concession, or Solution)
<!-- Did the developer make a fatal error and cave to the mob (Concession)? Was the claim dismantled by technical programming observation (Vindication)? Or are you providing a copy-pasteable text patch to shield this specific pipeline? -->

### V. Verifiable Source Material
<!-- Provide direct links to verifiable sources: Steam store disclosures, developer patch notes, archived community forum pins, or technical analyst breakdowns. Submissions without data links will be rejected. -->
